nodes.name: Weekly Cron — Mon 9am ET
nodes.notes: Cron is 13:00 UTC = 09:00 America/New_York. Confirm the workflow timezone in Settings is America/New_York. Monday morning chosen so the prior week is fully closed before comparison.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  account_id,
  account_name,
  amplitude_project_id,
  segment,
  drop_threshold_pct,
  min_baseline_events,
  csm_slack_user_id,
  last_alerted_at
FROM accounts_in_scope
WHERE active = true
  AND csm_slack_user_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY account_id
LIMIT 500;

nodes.name: Pull Accounts In Scope
nodes.notes: accounts_in_scope holds per-account threshold, min baseline floor, and the owning CSM's Slack user id. Per-account threshold lets enterprise run tighter than self-serve.

nodes.name: Batch Accounts (20/group)
nodes.notes: Batches keep parallel Amplitude calls under the rate cap and bound retry blast radius. Amplitude's Dashboard REST API caps concurrency low — 20/group with the downstream Wait keeps us safe.

nodes.name: Amplitude — Weekly Actives (14d)
nodes.notes: Pulls 14 days of weekly-unique actives segmented by account_id user-property. i=7 buckets by week so the response carries two weekly points: last week and the week before. Adjust the event_type and the gp:account_id property name to match your Amplitude taxonomy.

nodes.name: Compute WoW Drop
nodes.notes: min_baseline_events is the noise guard: an account with 4 actives last week dropping to 2 is a 50% drop but not a signal. Below the floor we mark skipped_low_baseline and never alert.

parameters.query:
SELECT alerted_at
FROM usage_alert_history
WHERE account_id = $1
  AND alerted_at > now() - interval '14 days'
ORDER BY alerted_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Lookup Recent Alert
nodes.notes: Cooldown lookup: if this account was already alerted in the last 14 days, suppress the repeat so a sustained dip does not ping the CSM every Monday.

nodes.name: Slack — DM Owning CSM
nodes.notes: channel set to the CSM's Slack user id sends a DM. The bot must have im:write and chat:write scopes and the user must allow DMs from apps. Swap the channel for a shared #cs-usage-alerts channel if you prefer a team feed.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.account_id }},{{ $('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.week_before }},{{ $('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.last_week }},{{ $('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.drop_pct }},{{ $('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.threshold }},{{ JSON.stringify($('Compute WoW Drop').item.json.reason) }}

nodes.name: Persist Alert (idempotent per week)
nodes.notes: ON CONFLICT key (account_id, week) keeps a retried run from double-DMing the CSM and double-logging. last_alerted_at on accounts_in_scope is the fast-path cooldown read.
